mentions.name: Macscope
mentions.description: A macOS window management app that acts as a better Cmd+Tab. A quick tap of a shortcut switches apps normally, while holding it opens an interface with unified search across windows, apps, and browser tabs; Scopes to save and restore entire window layouts per project (useful after unplugging a monitor); and Placement Modes that snap windows to screen halves as you switch to them.
mentions.problem: macOS window management feels slow compared to the keyboard-driven speed of a terminal or code editor.
mentions.source_excerpt: I'm working on Macscope (https://macscope.app), a better Cmd+Tab for macOS. I built it because macOS window management feels slow compared to the keyboard-driven speed of a terminal or code editor.
